scope: Offline truth-anchored evaluation of a deployable blind scan statistic. Truth/ADS-B is not an input to the proposed detector.

method.definition: For each scanned quadratic motion-bank path, average the per-frame local power-ratio values in dB (equivalently: 10*log10 of the geometric mean of linear local ratios). Select the best path at every tested anchor.
method.bank: 3 delay velocities x 3 Doppler velocities x 3 delay accelerations x 3 Doppler accelerations = 81 paths
method.false_alarm_reference: For each target clip, threshold against the maximum (the implementation's empirical p99) of 64-80 independently optimized nearby control anchors using the identical bank.

robustness_check: Seven quantiles, seven symmetric trims, signed-rank, four count thresholds and four run-length thresholds were tested. Of the temporal summaries that retain r277, only the geometric mean gives r13 a material positive margin; count/run >= 6 dB are only +0.0015/+0.0011 dB.
decision: Candidate for a blind replay scan: recover r13 while retaining r277 and rejecting r12/r94 under their matched control maxima. Do not promote to deployment yet: the r13 clearance is only 0.110 dB and the statistic family was evaluated post hoc; require held-out replays and a global all-anchor false-alarm scan.
